timing: After the first successful API verification, before execution of revised group-policy and explicit probability checks. This is a post-initial-run software validation expansion, not preregistration.

group_policy_refinement.reason: Shared identity is a property that becomes a protocol violation only when the declared estimand requires disjoint groups. Known-object/new-view recognition legitimately reuses object IDs.
group_policy_refinement.original_fixture_truth: Existing group-overlap fault fixtures implicitly require group-disjoint validation. Rerun will explicitly pass group_policy=disjoint without changing fixture bytes.
additional_real_controls: COIL20 pose split with overlap_allowed must retain 20 shared object IDs but not flag them as a group protocol failure
COIL20 pose split with unspecified group policy must report UNKNOWN rather than infer an unseen-object scientific claim

probability_validation.reason: Optional prob_* columns were present in archived wheat tables, but the initial API did not claim or validate them. Explicit class-to-column mapping will test finite values, range, simplex and mapping completeness.
controls: all mapped probabilities finite and in [0,1], row sum one
unmapped probability columns are explicitly unaudited rather than silently certified

unchanged_limits: Probability consistency does not establish calibration, uncertainty accuracy or label truth.
Group-disjoint metadata does not establish independent physical specimens.
Declared fitting membership does not certify actual execution or absence of historical target peeking.
